 Match Preview
 Premier League - Game Week 10 7 Nov 2026 - 10:00 Craven Cottage Fulham host Newcastle United at Craven Cottage in a Premier League fixture that arrives at a difficult moment for the Magpies, who travel to London searching for a response after a turbulent week on Tyneside.
 Alvaro Arbeloa's Fulham have been solid at home this season and enter the match in reasonable shape, sitting 15th in the table but with back-to-back Premier League wins in recent weeks providing a degree of confidence heading into this one.
 Newcastle, currently 13th, have lost four of their last five fixtures and were beaten twice by Everton inside the space of a week. The mood at St James' Park has turned sour, with boos greeting the players at full time following the home defeat to the Toffees.
 Manager Matthias Jaissle is under mounting pressure but has publicly stated he retains the full support of the club's board. He faces a testing afternoon at Craven Cottage without several key players, with Joelinton ruled out through injury and Jacob Ramsey suspended.
 Fulham will be aware that Newcastle remain capable of producing away performances, having won 2-0 at Crystal Palace in their most recent road fixture. The Magpies will need that level of output again if they are to arrest a slide that has unsettled supporters and staff alike.
